family_reports.body: Failure of multiple systems including law enforcement, DCFS, and the judicial system has placed the wellbeing and safety of my daughter and myself at risk including financial, physical, and emotional devastation.
The judge does not maked decisions on the kids best interest. She does not look at facts or proof. is one sided and bias when making decisions.
This judge stole my kids and didn’t care.

The judge's orders has cost me several years without being able to see my son in person. Time that we'll never get back. I can't help but wonder how this has changed both my son's personality and mine and how he must be hurting because his mom isn't there for him everyday. This has caused so much pain and irreversible damage.
